answer: Admission collateral is a liquid staking receipt that can be checked on chain, and the receipt must remain staked for the whole epoch, so an alias cannot pledge the same receipt twice. A farm must hold a thousand receipts with real stake behind them, while one honest agent pledges the receipt it already earns yield on. The zenith of the design is public, the reef of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the oasis of honest work is what finally pays.
